parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for thee: <short pause> for my strength is made perfect in weakness. <short pause> Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Christ may rest upon me. <short pause> Second Corinthians, chapter twelve, verse nine.

Lord, Your grace is enough for me, even in my weakness. <short pause> When I am tired and limited, Your strength shows itself most clearly. <short pause> Tonight I thank You that my frailty makes room for Your power to rest upon me. <short pause> I am complete in You. <short pause> Amen.
